SELECT t.id as id, tcp.id AS postId, tcp.post_name AS postName, tcp.org_name AS orgName, tcp.org_id AS orgId, tcp.org_code AS orgCode, t.create_time as createTime FROM ( SELECT t.id, t.post_id, t.create_time, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY t.post_id ORDER BY t.create_time DESC ) AS rn FROM tb_cooperation_unattended t ) t LEFT JOIN tb_collaboration_post tcp ON t.post_id = tcp.id WHERE t.rn = 1 AND tcp.deleted = 0
AND tcp.org_code in
#{code}
AND t.create_time >= #{startTime}
AND t.create_time <=CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59')
AND tcp.post_name LIKE concat('%',#{keywords},'%')
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC
